title: Evaporators & Crystallizers
summary: Custom evaporators and crystallization equipment for concentration, thermal separation and crystal/slurry handling duties.
body:
Tongyang supports fabrication of evaporators, crystallization vessels and associated equipment for liquid concentration and selected solid-liquid processing duties. Configuration depends strongly on feed properties, heat sensitivity, fouling behavior and utilities.

Typical applications

  • Concentration of chemical and industrial liquid streams
  • Evaporation with vapor-liquid separation
  • Crystallization and crystal-slurry handling services
  • Thermal process packages with vessels, heat exchangers and auxiliaries as specified

Key technical parameters for quotation

  • Feed: composition, throughput, temperature, viscosity, solids and fouling tendency
  • Product target: final concentration, evaporation rate, crystal size or recovery requirement
  • Operating mode: batch/continuous, pressure/vacuum, allowable temperature and residence time
  • Utilities: steam/heating medium, cooling water, available power and energy requirements
  • Equipment: material, corrosion/erosion allowance, agitation/circulation, cleanability and discharge

Engineering & manufacturing basis

Equipment may include evaporator bodies, heat-transfer sections, vapor separators, crystallization vessels and related mechanical auxiliaries. Pressure-containing parts are reviewed to the agreed design code, while process configuration, mass/energy balance and product performance require verified feed data and a defined process-engineering scope.

Quotation basis: provide feed/product specifications, throughput, utilities and available flow diagrams. Bench or pilot testing may be needed for difficult crystallization, high-viscosity or fouling services.
seoDescription: Custom evaporators and crystallizers for industrial concentration, thermal separation and slurry handling, based on feed properties and utility conditions.
